libopenmpt.worklet.js is the unmodified engine from chiptune3 0.8.10
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/chiptune3/v/0.8.10, integrity
sha512-TXe8OMw2EyS744LC5dMODVk46DVQL9i/dahFfArUZf2WwS4Uyarm3rXZPAVlF2+zta/Vl7TnBT563WbkwcRjVA==).
Upstream: https://github.com/DrSnuggles/chiptune/tree/v3. It bundles libopenmpt,
miniz and stb_vorbis; their notices follow.
